data.title: JPMorgan Deploys JPM Coin on Ethereum Mainnet — Institutional Stablecoin Payments Go Multi-Chain
data.description: JPMorgan has expanded the reach of its JPM Coin, making the token available to institutional clients on the Ethereum mainnet as of October 19, 2026. The move, reported by CoinDesk, follows the initial launch of the token on the Coinbase-linked layer-2 network Base in November 2025 and marks a shift in how the bank approaches […]
